topic: Rome, 80 CE: the Colosseum opened and could hold about 50,000 people, with a giant cloth roof (velarium) for shade.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Rome’s Giant Sunshade

shots.narration: A sparkle jump lands us beside something enormous!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated adventure look; ancient Rome beside the Colosseum, bright sunlight, golden time-travel sparkles and swirling dust, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya materializes beside Tock in a burst of golden sparkles.
shots.mood: Glowing blue wristwatch, towering stone arches, welcoming golden light.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, richly detailed ancient Roman plaza outside the newly completed Colosseum, pale stone paving and sunlit arcades, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya points up at the Colosseum.
shots.mood: Wide-eyed wonder beneath an immense bright facade.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, shaded entrance arch of the newly completed Colosseum, clean stonework and bright daylight beyond, no lettering.
shots.action: Tock bounces beneath the entrance arch.
shots.mood: Playful brass reflections against monumental stone.

shots.narration: Inside, rows of seats stretch all around.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Colosseum interior overlooking sweeping tiers of empty stone seats and the sandy arena, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the sweeping seating tiers.
shots.mood: Grand sunlit curves surrounding a tiny delighted explorer.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide Colosseum interior with immense empty seating tiers encircling the arena, Zoya and Tock small in the foreground, no lettering.
shots.action: Tock extends one tiny leg toward the distant seats.
shots.mood: Astonishing scale, warm stone and clear blue sky.

shots.narration: [sighs] But this sunny seat feels much too hot.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, exposed stone seating inside the Colosseum under strong sunlight, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya fans her face with her hand.
shots.mood: Bright glare, flushed cheeks and a gently comic pout.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit Colosseum seating aisle with a shaded seating section visible nearby, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya shades her eyes with one hand.
shots.mood: Searching eyes and a clear contrast between sunshine and shade.

shots.narration: Tock spots a giant cloth sunshade overhead.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, upward view from Colosseum seating toward broad cloth awnings supported by ropes, open sky above the arena, no lettering.
shots.action: Tock points upward at the cloth awnings.
shots.mood: Cream fabric glowing softly against a brilliant blue sky.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Colosseum seating beneath the velarium, broad cloth panels overhead with an open central sky, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya tilts her head toward the velarium.
shots.mood: Curious upturned face beneath sweeping fabric and taut ropes.

shots.narration: The velarium helped shade the spectators.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Colosseum seating aisle crossing from bright sunlight into shade cast by the cloth velarium, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya steps into the shaded seating section.
shots.mood: A crisp shadow edge and visibly softer light around Zoya.

shots.narration: A shady seat makes exploring feel much better.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, shaded stone bench inside the Colosseum, Tock beside Zoya and sunlit seating beyond, no lettering.
shots.action: Zoya settles onto the shaded bench.
shots.mood: Relaxed shoulders, happy smile and cool gentle shadows.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, shaded Colosseum seating with the velarium overhead, Zoya's blue wristwatch glowing beside Tock, no lettering.
shots.action: Tock turns his round glass face toward Zoya to ask his question.
shots.mood: Eager robot expression, bright blue watchlight and a hint of golden sparkles.

episode.endHook: The blue watch glows again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Rome, 80 CE, when the Colosseum opened. They discover its enormous capacity and learn how a giant cloth sunshade called the velarium helped shade spectators.
